## About
Davon Auto started in David Vonbokern's garage and has been growing ever since. Today the crew works out of Boron Drive in Latonia, taking care of collision, sale and service needs for neighbors across Covington.
The team includes specialists in fiberglass work, paint jobs and alignment work, plus a service department for everyday maintenance and repairs. One reviewer brings both work fleet vehicles and personal cars here, and another says their kids get their cars serviced here too.
We know car repair isn't fun or convenient for most people, so we try to make it as easy as we can. That means explaining what's going on, what to expect, and what actually needs to be done.

## Services
- Auto repair: From head gasket to tailpipe, done with honesty, quality and value.
- Preventative maintenance: From vehicle inspections to tune-ups.
- Flushes ($120 - $300)
- Alignments: Done on modern alignment machines in our shop.
- Collision center: Our own collision center on site.
- In house towing: We can bring your vehicle to the shop ourselves.
- Detailing: A fine cleaning detail with a minimum of 3 hours spent on your vehicle. Some stains and animal hair can add to the price. (Starts at $150, SUV/truck $200)
- Leather interiors: Leather is ordered through Katzkin. Call for pricing and to start designing.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with fleet accounts?
A: Yes. We offer Net 30 billing and work with most major fleet management programs, including ARI, Lease Plan and Enterprise.

Q: Can you help with insurance after an accident?
A: One reviewer said David and Jordan took the time to explain how to navigate the at-fault driver's insurance after a wreck.

Q: How do I get a price on my repair?
A: Prices depend on your vehicle and the work needed, so give us a call to schedule an appointment and we'll go over pricing.

Q: How soon will I hear back if I use the contact form?
A: If a reply is needed, you will hear back within 48-72 hours. For anything sooner, call the shop.

In the chaotic aftermath of both accidents, David and Jordan were the calm, steady voices I needed. They took the time to explain what was happening, what to expect, and how to navigate the at‑fault driver’s insurance — easily the most frustrating part of the entire ordeal.

Both vehicles were rebuilt beautifully, but what meant even more was how they protected my time, my wallet, and my sanity throughout the process. Their knowledge and patience made me feel genuinely cared for. I walked away better informed and with complete trust in their work and their integrity.

I recommend Davon Auto wholeheartedly and without hesitation!" (Meredith McMillen, 5/5)
